name: Muma Shoujo Sylvie
source:
Silvy the lolita soulsucking succubus latches onto a freeter otaku.

He's got the libido she wants and she's got the looks he loves, Silvy takes his virginity and then some, milking him into a blackout... 

The next day, the otaku wakes up as horny and virile as ever.

"I've never met anyone with such a wealth of sperm and durability... Impeccable."

From that day, awestruck Silvy milked him again and again and again...... 

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE171612.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
吸食灵魂的萝莉魅魔希尔维缠上了一名自由职业宅男。

他拥有她渴望的性欲，她拥有他喜爱的外表。希尔维夺走他的处男之身，又让他射精到昏迷……

第二天，宅男醒来时依旧精力旺盛、欲望高涨。

“我从没见过精子这么充足、持久力这么强的人……完美。”

从那天起，惊叹不已的希尔维一次又一次地榨取他……
